title: My working schedule
subtitle: Review your current schedule and plan future appointment hours.
monthHint: We display 3 months from the selected date. The Zone A / Zone B boundary is the end of the rolling bookable window.

zoneA.title: Current schedule
zoneA.callout: Parameters for this period are frozen. Only cancellations or vacation on empty days are available.
zoneA.cancelReasonHint: The patient will see this in the cancellation notification
zoneA.vacationHint: Only for days with no appointments after bulk cancel

zoneB.title: Future schedule
zoneB.callout: New parameters apply from {{date}} — the first day after Zone A.
zoneB.priceHint: Applies from the first day after Zone A · profile shows bookable price

important.title: Good to know
important.b1: Format affects which slots patients see in search.
important.b2: Bulk cancel in Zone A sends a notification to each affected patient.
important.b3: Zone B changes do not auto-cancel existing bookings.

modals.bulkBody: Cancel appointments for the selected scope in Zone A? Patients will be notified.
modals.vacationABody: Mark the selected day as vacation? Only when the day has no appointments.
modals.vacationBBody: Enable vacation / day off for the future period?
modals.saveBBody: Apply new hours, duration, format, and price from {{date}}?
